Barr Trying Again to Silence DC’s Medical Marijuana Vote—
Bill Coming to House Floor Tomorrow – DRCNet Alert

(Marijuananews note: I confess to mixed feelings about this. It is obviously outrageous that the Congress has blocked counting the votes. On the other hand, if the votes are counted, Congress will simply block the implementation of the law.

We are indeed fortunate in having in Barr an enemy as stupid as he is vicious. He is the sort of person who gives viciousness a bad name. So if the Congress again rides roughshod over democracy, we can make the most of it. In the meantime, people in D.C. who need medical marijuana will still have to resort to the black market.

All the foregoing not withstanding, I would urge everyone to protest this action. It may not do anything for seriously ill people, but it might be good for a very sick democracy.)

ALERT: Bob Barr Trying Again to Silence DC’s Medical Marijuana Vote—Bill Coming to House Floor Tuesday!

-------- PLEASE COPY AND DISTRIBUTE --------

-------- PLEASE COPY AND DISTRIBUTE --------

-------- PLEASE COPY AND DISTRIBUTE --------

From www.drcnet.org/releasethevote/

7/24/99

Dear Friend,

Last year, Rep. Bob Barr (R-GA) introduced a shameful bill that forbids the District of Colombia government from using even its own funds to count or certify the results of DC’s medical marijuana initiative last year, I-59, which according to an exit poll gained 69% of the vote. ALMOST NINE MONTHS SINCE THE ELECTION, CITIZENS IN THE NATION’S CAPITAL ARE STILL WAITING TO HEAR THE OFFICIAL RESULTS OF THEIR VOTE. Our sources tell us that Rep. Barr intends to introduce an amendment to the District Appropriations Bill on Tuesday, 7/24, to extend his ban for another year, even though the same amendment failed in committee last week.

The Barr amendment is flagrantly unconstitutional and represents a fundamental attack on democracy, and is enormously cruel to seriously ill patients who need marijuana for medical reasons, but who risk arrest, incarceration and loss of property when they use it. Please visit http://www.drcnet.org/releasethevote/ to find out how to send an e-mail or fax to your Representative and your two Senators, that you want them to obey the Constitution, defeat Bob Barr’s shameful bill, and RELEASE THE VOTE!

Please forward this alert to your friends and to appropriate forums and newsgroups, or click on the "Tell a Friend" link on the web site. Last but not least, write down your Rep’s phone number (the petition form will show it), and follow up on Monday morning with a phone call, to make even more of an impact. (If you can’t get to the web, you can also call the Congressional Switchboard at (202) 224-3121, and ask them to look up your Representative and transfer your call to his or her office.)
